name: Secure Boot Analysis
description: Assessment of secure boot implementations in embedded devices. Covers analysis of boot chain trust anchors (hardware root of trust, OTP fuses, eFuses), signature verification logic, chain-of-trust integrity, boot mode vulnerabilities, and bypass techniques including rollback attacks and fault injection against boot verification. Scope is embedded and SoC boot chains; PC/UEFI platform firmware and Secure Boot belong to SWSEC-PLATFORM-UEFI.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to secure boot mechanisms

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands secure boot concepts, trust chains, and common architectures
evidence: Can explain a typical secure boot chain (ROM bootloader, signed stages, kernel verification)
Understands hardware root of trust concepts (OTP fuses, eFuses, immutable ROM)
Aware of common secure boot bypass categories (signature bypass, rollback, fault injection)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Analyzes documented secure boot implementations under supervision
evidence: Maps the boot chain of a target device using firmware analysis and documentation
Identifies signature verification routines in bootloader firmware
Tests for known secure boot vulnerabilities (e.g., unsigned secondary stages) under guidance
Documents boot chain trust boundaries and potential attack surfaces

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses secure boot implementations and identifies weaknesses
evidence: Reverse engineers undocumented boot chains and maps trust boundaries without assistance
Identifies and exploits implementation flaws in signature verification logic
Assesses anti-rollback protections and version enforcement mechanisms
Completed secure boot assessments on 3+ distinct SoC platforms independently

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Breaks hardened secure boot implementations; combines software and hardware attacks
evidence: Combines fault injection with software techniques to bypass secure boot verification
Exploits TOC/TOU vulnerabilities in boot chain implementations
Develops custom tooling to automate secure boot analysis workflows
Reviews and mentors junior analysts on secure boot assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on secure boot security; publishes research; advises silicon vendors
evidence: Published research on novel secure boot bypass techniques
Provides expert consultation to silicon vendors on secure boot architecture
Defines the lab's secure boot assessment methodology
Authored CVEs against secure boot implementations in shipping products

assessment_methods.description: Assess the secure boot implementation of a target device: map the trust chain, identify weaknesses, and demonstrate a bypass if feasible
Review secure boot analysis reports for completeness of trust chain mapping and quality of vulnerability assessment
